back.target: except, apart from, besides (preposition taking the dative)
back.example: Everyone is already here except Max.

note: The two-word "bis auf" (alle bis auf Tom) also means except, but the one-word bracket points to außer; the editor could mention in the grammar or a later card that außer takes the dative (außer mir, außer dem Lehrer), since the example uses only a bare name.
